outcome: composite neonatal adverse outcome (Apgar score less than 5 at 5 minutes, assisted ventilation for more than 6 hours, seizure, or death)
composite maternal adverse outcome (intensive care unit admission, blood transfusion, uterine rupture, or unplanned hysterectomy)
cohort: Over 4.3 million low-risk, nulliparous individuals with nonanomalous singleton pregnancies who labored and delivered at 37-41 weeks of gestation in the United States between 2015 and 2019
finding: Non-Hispanic Black and Hispanic individuals experienced a significantly higher risk of primary cesarean delivery compared to non-Hispanic White individuals, with this disparity remaining stable throughout the study period.
mod_finding: Non-Hispanic Black and Hispanic individuals had a higher adjusted relative risk for primary cesarean delivery compared to non-Hispanic White individuals.
